links.outcome: Retention of original safety alignment after medical fine-tuning of MLLMs
links.effect: Medical fine-tuning frequently induced catastrophic forgetting of the base model's safety alignment (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Furthermore, we find that the medical fine-tuning process frequently induces catastrophic forgetting of the model's original safety alignment.

links.outcome: Vulnerability of Medical MLLMs to adversarial and jailbreak inputs
links.effect: Pervasive safety vulnerabilities across general and medical dimensions, with particular fragility to cross-modality jailbreak attacks (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Our empirical analysis reveals pervasive vulnerabilities across both general and medical-specific safety dimensions in existing models, particularly highlighting their fragility against cross-modality jailbreak attacks.

screen.reason: Evaluates medical MLLM safety against jailbreaks/vulnerabilities and benchmarks a post-hoc safety grafting intervention to restore safety alignment without degrading clinical capability.
